The '''Royal Kalindan Mounted Police''' were a [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|law enforcement agency]] based on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kirima (Kalinda system)|Kirima]]. They wore maroon jackets with gold trim, with everything else, including their helmets, colored in black.
